lines.text: You will build a dance party with dancers, music and flashing lights — all with loops.
You need at least two dancers that change costumes in a loop.
Add a beat that keeps playing, and backdrops that change like disco lights.
And when someone clicks a dancer, it does a special move.
Here are three forever loops: one for the dance, one for the beat, and one for the lights.
They all run at the same time when you click the green flag!
For the show-stopper, use a repeat loop to spin all the way round, then say Ta-da!
Plan it, build it, test it, and have fun. Let the party begin!
